derivedBy: hand, from the stated dimensions in coffee-table.design.md; never regenerated from napkin's output

overall.derivation: The top's stated plan size, 48" x 24": 48 x 1024 = 49152 and 24 x 1024 = 24576. Nothing overhangs the top, so the table's extent is the top's.

boxes.name: Leg, south-west
boxes.derivation: Inset 1 1/2" from the top's west and south edges: 1.5 x 1024 = 1536 in both axes. 2 1/2" square = 2.5 x 1024 = 2560. Occupies x 1536..4096, y 1536..4096.

boxes.name: Leg, south-east
boxes.derivation: Its east face is inset 1 1/2" from the top's east edge, so the face is at 48 - 1.5 = 46.5" and the anchor (the west face) at 46.5 - 2.5 = 44": 44 x 1024 = 45056. Same y as the south-west leg. Occupies x 45056..47616.

boxes.name: Leg, north-west
boxes.derivation: North face inset 1 1/2" from the top's north edge: face at 24 - 1.5 = 22.5", anchor at 22.5 - 2.5 = 20": 20 x 1024 = 20480. Same x as the south-west leg. Occupies y 20480..23040.

boxes.name: Leg, north-east
boxes.derivation: The east x of the south-east leg with the north y of the north-west leg: (45056, 20480).

boxes.name: Apron, long, south
boxes.derivation: Runs between the legs along X: from the south-west leg's east face at 1.5 + 2.5 = 4" (4 x 1024 = 4096) to the south-east leg's west face at 44". Length 44 - 4 = 40" = 40960. Its south face is flush with the legs' south faces at y = 1.5" = 1536; thickness 3/4" = 768, so it occupies y 1536..2304.

boxes.name: Apron, long, north
boxes.derivation: Same length and thickness as the south long apron. Its north face is flush with the legs' north faces at y = 22.5", so the anchor (the south face) is at 22.5 - 0.75 = 21.75": 21.75 x 1024 = 22272. Occupies y 22272..23040.

boxes.name: Apron, short, west
boxes.derivation: Runs between the legs along Y: from the south-west leg's north face at 1.5 + 2.5 = 4" to the north-west leg's south face at 20". Length 20 - 4 = 16" = 16 x 1024 = 16384. Its west face is flush with the legs' west faces at x = 1.5" = 1536; thickness 3/4" = 768, so it occupies x 1536..2304.

boxes.name: Apron, short, east
boxes.derivation: Same length and thickness as the west short apron. Its east face is flush with the legs' east faces at x = 46.5", so the anchor (the west face) is at 46.5 - 0.75 = 45.75": 45.75 x 1024 = 46848. Occupies x 46848..47616.

dimensionLabels.name: Leg width
dimensionLabels.derivation: 2560 / 1024 = 2.5"; under a foot, so no feet are shown: 2 and 8/16 reduced to 1/2.

dimensionLabels.name: Leg inset from the top's west edge
dimensionLabels.derivation: The south-west leg's south-west corner is at x = 1536 and the top's at x = 0, so the signed distance along X is 1536 - 0 = 1536 = 1.5".

notes: Plan view only: the scene carries no third dimension, so no test asserts one.
